body:
## Change

F1. Recheck AbortSignal after synchronous activating progress notification, before activation commit. A listener-triggered cancellation now pauses without changing active generation.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN aborts from real installer progress callback and verifies paused result, no complete phase, generation0/current null. Parent reviewed checkpoint ordering and reran 43 installer/gameplay tests. Worker boundaries: 52; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Installed-runtime WASM integration could not load missing generated candidate fixture; no acquisition or recovery-marker bypass. Regression uses local installer/storage fixtures. Full CI has sampled asset-acquisition failures; no full-CI-green claim.
title: fix(content): honor cancellation before activation commit
